Scope: Read-only committed T14 runtime/entry/outcome/runner and regression design review with clean actual-shell static reports. Reviewer did not execute application suites, native PDF engines or acquisitions.

ObservedChecks: Both PDFtk and Ghostscript require a positive frozen expected page total before staging/native work. GS separately requires an existing literal canonical selected PDFtk inspection executable shorter than 260 UTF-16 characters.
Common staged gate requires native conversion success, a nonempty regular owned PDF, existing bounded envelope/native PDFtk inspection and exact positive expected page equality.

Explicit presence of Started, ExitCode, Succeeded, TimedOut, Cancelled, LaunchError, CaptureError, TerminationError, StdoutTruncated and StderrTruncated precedes validation-flag checks, independent of caller StrictMode.
Inspection execution must be successful and complete; merge/conversion and validation receipts remain distinct.
Stage/destination ownership, reparse status and staged metadata are rechecked around inspection. The published master is snapshotted before GS and rechecked after derivative inspection.

Only a strictly smaller validated GS derivative reaches unchanged T12 no-overwrite publication. Equal/larger output is validated, unpublished, no_size_benefit with no output error and successful requested-job status.
Small Get-PdfMergeOutcome consumes explicit publication/email state, provides 0/1/2 and explicit final paths, and performs no filesystem inference.
SkipEmail bypasses GS discovery, version probes and native launch. Missing optional GS, skip and no-benefit are complete master-only zero results.

Master publication/validation state is captured immediately upon merge receipt return, before native logging; later optional/discovery/logging exceptions preserve the master and map to partial success.
Owned stage cleanup precedes final summary. Cleanup diagnostics retain exact orphan paths; no published file is a cleanup target.
Existing BAT captures ERRORLEVEL before presentation/pause and forwards exact 0/1/2 unchanged.

Runner adds only the EmailOutcome tier and required development/native arguments/evidence label. No runtime network/Python, new engine, broader preset interface, source mutation, framework or T15 interruption implementation was added.
CodeReview.ResolvedReviewPoint: Receipt completeness originally relied on caller StrictMode. The explicit required-property presence guard and two strict-off regression designs now resolve that defensive gap.
TestDesignReview: New 72-case unit design covers explicit outcome states, unknown/missing decisions, source/foreign/master hashes, expected-count/inspector preconditions, strict smaller/equal/larger decisions, malformed/page mismatched outputs, complete inspection flags and strict-off missing-field refusal.

Unit faults include failed GS partials, inspector failures, changed stage/master metadata, ownership/reparse refusal, final file/directory collisions, no-benefit caller-stage cleanup and exact orphan diagnostics.
Legacy 38 master and 12 invocation cases are retained with updated GS preconditions, not removed. Fixture hash preload avoids accidental module auto-load under a global filesystem-decision mock.

Native EmailOutcome has 11 current cases for missing GS, skip sentinel, actual smaller raster derivative, actual no-benefit text derivative, genuine GS partial failure using a disclosed separate corrupt input, controlled expected-page mismatch, two post-master exceptions and actual cmd/BAT 0/1/2 propagation.

Native source/master hashes, independent pinned PDFium visible identifiers/page count/dimensions, conversion/inspection receipts and explicit output listing assertions distinguish actual engines from copied-helper controlled faults.
PS5.1 dimension assertions compare numbers directly, avoiding culture-dependent joined decimal strings. Failed dirty attempts remain historical evidence, not clean acceptance.

Assessment: Both actual shells have zero errors, 108 warnings and 42 information findings with identical category counts.
26 Write-Host warnings concern console entry or test diagnostics.
17 ShouldProcess warnings concern private owned-resource/process and fixture helpers. No public WhatIf surface was introduced.

25 unused parameter and 18 declaration-use warnings concern Pester mock/display parameters or cross-block fixtures, observations, hash and environment restoration variables; reviewed references do not reveal a T14 defect.
Eight singular-noun and three approved-verb warnings are naming suggestions.
Nine automatic input-variable assignments occur only in direct non-pipeline test fixture usage, including one new email native application helper; naming cleanup is nonblocking.
Two missing-BOM warnings concern existing non-ASCII comments in entry and PDFtk path tests, not executable path literals.
Information comprises 36 positional test-helper calls and six existing OutputType metadata suggestions.
All findings remain retained. This is scoped static review, not lint-clean or full T22 acceptance.

RemainingLimitations: Snapshot checks use length/last-write metadata and ownership/reparse guards; they do not prove transactionally immutable files or every hostile mutation between checks.
Envelope, strict page totals and the synthetic visible corpus do not certify universal PDF validity/security, features, signatures or full fidelity.
Controlled staged data/count/discovery/logging faults are distinct from real engine execution and are disclosed by the native designs.
Abrupt interruption, owned process descendants and cancellation behavior remain T15; cleanup is best effort.
EmailPreset and remaining public-parameter behavior remain T16; broader quality/preset evidence is later work.
No Explorer, live UNC, other platform/architecture, full runner/launcher sweep, CI, package or published-release acceptance is claimed.

EvidenceAudit.Method: Independent read-only raw driver command/aggregate/summary/NUnit/stream, native observation, retained synthetic/runtime/dependency hash, recorded native-audit, exact archive payload/privacy and fresh live-ref inspection. No suite or PDF-engine execution by this reviewer.
EvidenceAudit.UncapturedAuditAttempt: full1 has no standalone receipt/log/source SHA/count; tool-transcript assertion is disclosed but not independently replayed by this reviewer.

ClosureDraftReview.Limits: Reviewed planned records-only writes/guards and exact ten retained diagnostic whitespace files; root still owns execution, staged-blob verification, C2 commit/push and fresh clean equality.
